video.title: BEFORE BED, SPEAK THESE 5 WORDS AND PRAY FOR AN OVERNIGHT MIRACLE || Blessed Fulton Sheen
video.description:
Can a simple prayer before sleep transform your heart, strengthen your faith, and help you place your worries completely in God's hands?

In this powerful spiritual message, Venerable Fulton J. Sheen shares timeless wisdom about prayer, faith, God's grace, surrender, trust, and the power of turning to God before we rest.

The words we speak in prayer can reflect what is happening within our hearts. Rather than relying on superstition or treating prayer as a formula for guaranteed miracles, this message encourages us to approach God with faith, humility, trust, and a sincere heart.

5 WORDS TO TRIGGER AN OVERNIGHT MIRACLE WHILE YOU SLEEP | VENERABLE FULTON SHEEN



WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER:

• 5 powerful words to reflect on before sleep  
• Why nighttime prayer can strengthen your spiritual life  
• How surrendering your worries to God can bring peace  
• The connection between faith, trust, and prayer  
• Why God's will matters when we ask for blessings  
• Timeless spiritual lessons associated with Venerable Fulton J. Sheen  

Before you sleep tonight, pause for a moment. Put your worries aside, pray sincerely, and entrust your life and future to God.

🙏 Pray with faith, not superstition. Ask God for His grace, guidance, peace, and will to be done.

If this message touches your heart, share it with someone who needs encouragement or peace tonight.

🔔 Subscribe to THE HIDDEN GOSPEL for timeless Christian teachings, prayer, faith, spiritual wisdom, biblical reflections, and inspiring messages associated with Venerable Fulton J. Sheen.

transcript.text: Before they heal, before they deliver, before that overnight miracle you have been praying for.
But before we get there, I want you to understand something foundational.
God delights in doing miracles for his children, but he does them his way.
He honors faith, he honors his word, and he honors rest.
Faith sleeps peacefully, because it knows the work is already done.
Do you want to hear what happened to me?
Uh, the night I learned this lesson, I will tell you.
One night, many years ago, I was praying late, battling in my body, weary in my mind.
And just as I was about to give in to despair, I heard the spirit again, softly but surely.
Go to bed, let me work.
I obeyed. I did not pray another word. I did not beg, did not plead.
I simply spoke the word one last time aloud.
Lord, you said it is finished. I believe it. Good night.
I woke up the next morning completely free.
Not a trace of the condition, gone, just gone.
And I knew why, because overnight, while I rested, angels moved because faith had spoken.
You see, my friends, overnight miracles are not fantasy.
They are the inheritance of those who trust enough to sleep in faith now.
Now, listen to me closely because what I am about to say may be the most important part of this message for some of you tonight.
The reason so many believers never receive their overnight miracle is not because God is unwilling, and it is certainly not because heaven lacks power.
The problem is not on God's end, it is right here in us.
The problem is this: we go to bed full of words God never told us to speak.
Some of you lay your head down at night with your mind rehearsing sickness, rehearsing fear, rehearsing failure.
You lie under the covers thinking, I don't know what is going to happen, what if it gets worse, what if I do not make it?
What if the money does not come? What if God does not show up this time?
Let me tell you something plainly in love, but with boldness: those are not faith words.
Those are not words the angels recognize.
Those are words the enemy feeds on.
Fear is a language too, doubt is a language too.
And just as faith activates the kingdom of heaven, fear activates the plans of the adversary.
God said in Job 3:25, 'The thing which I greatly feared is come upon me'.
Why? Because fear attracts what you dread, just as faith attracts what you desire from God.
And hear me tonight, some of you God's people have been going to bed feeding the wrong side of the supernatural.
Instead of declaring victory, you are rehearsing defeat.
Instead of resting in God's promises, you are wrestling in human reasoning.
Instead of speaking healing, you are speaking symptoms.
Instead of declaring provision, you are speaking lack.
And you wonder why angels do not move overnight, because they do not obey worry, they obey the word.
Psalm 103 to 20 seconds A's uh 'Bless the Lord, oh you his angels, you mighty ones who do his word, hearkening to the voice of his word'.
Notice it does not say they harken to your tears.
It does not say they harken to your fears, it does not even say they harken to your pain.
They obey the word spoken by faith.
I have sat across from too many precious saints wringing their hands, crying out to God, but then turning right around and undoing their prayer with words of defeat.
Father Groco, I just do not feel any better.
I guess God is not going to heal me after all.
I suppose this is just my cross to bear.
No, no, no, that is not the language of faith.
That is not the language that shakes heaven and commands angels into action.
That is the language of surrender, surrendering to circumstances, not to Christ.
That is the language that binds the hands of your miracle working angels and leaves you waking up in the morning wondering why nothing changed.
But listen to me now, you cannot speak fear and reap a harvest of faith.

transcript.text: You cannot speak sickness and reap healings fruit.
You cannot speak lack and walk in abundance.
Faith must be in your mouth if you want faith results.
That is why God told Joshua, the great general who would lead God's people into promise in Joshua 1 to 8.
This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth, for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
Did you catch it? Mouth first, success second, mouth first, miracle second.
Many of God's children speak faith in the daytime, but when the sun sets and the symptoms flare up, or the bills pile higher, they lay their heads down and let fear have the final say.
And that is why the miracle does not manifest overnight.
Let me tell you a story.
Years ago, there was a dear sister in one of my retreats.
She came forward for healing in her body.
I laid hands on her and prayed.
She rejoiced, she shouted.
She believed for about three hours.
When I spoke to her the next day, she said, uh Father, I guess it did not work.
I still feel the pain.
I looked her right in the eye and said, Sister, the healing did not leave you.
Your faith did.
The problem was not the prayer, the problem was not the word.
The problem was that when she laid down at night, she picked the sickness back up in her heart with words of doubt.
I am here to tell you tonight, you cannot speak two languages and expect heaven to respond.
Either you speak faith or you speak fear.
Either you declare the word or you declare the problem.
One loses angels, the other binds them.
One invites miracles, the other delays them.
This is why I told you in the beginning, overnight miracles belong to those who rest in faith, not wrestle in fear.
Your words matter, your posture matters, your confession matters.
And if you want to wake up whole, you must lie down victorious.
Now in a moment, I'm going to show you what to say.
I'm going to reveal the five divine words that angels recognize.
Words that unlock miracles while you sleep.
But first, we have to be honest with ourselves.
Are we sending angels out with bold commands of faith, or are we dismissing them with whispers of worry?
Tonight, I am going to show you how to fix that.
How to replace the language of fear with a decree of faith, because you are one declaration away from setting heaven in motion.
Now, I told you I was going to share something the Lord showed me, something I have never forgotten.

transcript.text: Every pain every ache seemed louder in the dark.
And the thoughts, oh the thoughts, what if this does not go away?
What if this gets worse? What if you are finished?
And then like a whisper from heaven, the Lord reminded me, you know the words, speak them. Rest.
So I got up from my bed, walked the floor, not pacing in fear, but walking in authority.
And with every step I spoke them aloud.
It is finished. Healing is mine. Jesus has won. Angels go now. I will rest.
I did not shout, I did not weep, I did not plead.
I spoke them like a general giving orders, because that is exactly what I was, a son of God enforcing a heavenly decree.
Then I laid down and I will tell you the truth, I slept like a baby.
No torment, no tossing, no fear creeping in, just peace he gives his beloved sleep.
Psalm 127:2.
But here is where it gets good.
In the middle of the night something woke me up, not fear, not pain, not restlessness.
Presence, holy presence.
The air in that room was thick, not oppressive, but weighty with peace.
And though my natural eyes could not see, in my spirit I knew angels were in the room.
Not because I deserved it, not because I prayed harder, but because I had spoken what heaven responds to.
And right there, lying still, I heard these words in my spirit so clearly, it felt audible.
While you rest, we work.
I smiled, whispered, thank you Lord, and went right back to sleep.
When I woke up, listen to me now, every symptom was gone.
Gone. No tightness, no pain, no fatigue.
It was like it had never been there.
Why? Because angels move on words spoken in faith.
Because faith does not strive.
Faith speaks and rests.
Because what Jesus finished on the cross becomes manifest when we align our mouth and our rest with his victory.
And this is not just for priests or preachers.
It is for you.
It is for the mother lying awake over a sick child.
It is for the man fighting fear in the night.
Ah, it is for the believer wrestling with diagnosis and debt and doubt.
These five words are not exclusive to me.
They belong to every child of God who dares to believe.
Faith is not about feeling something, faith is about knowing something.
And when you know your authority, when you speak it, when you rest in it, angels are activated.
Healing is released, miracles unfold, sometimes overnight, sometimes before the morning even breaks.
And I have seen it again and again.
People who have heard this message, who have spoken these five words with conviction, come back with testimonies of overnight breakthroughs.
Doctors confused, symptoms reversed, provision unlocked, peace restored.
Why? Because heaven does not operate on human clocks.
Heaven operates on covenant words spoken in faith.
And my friends, if he did it for me, he will do it for you now.

transcript.text: Step 4, physically relax as a sign of spiritual trust.
Some of you need to hear this.
Rest is faith in action.
Lay your head down knowing you have said what needs saying.
You have loosed what needs loosing.
You have believed what needs believing.
There is no need to rehearse the problem again.
No need to toss and turn.
No need to replay every symptom.
Every worry, every report.
Rest is your final act of faith for the day.
It is like signing a contract and putting down the pen.
You do not rewrite it after you have signed it.
You rest in what is done.
Step 5, expect to wake up to testimony.
This is not wishful thinking.
This is scriptural expectation.
Psalm 30 to 5 seconds A's.
Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning.
Go to bed expecting good news.
Expecting change, expecting angels to have done their work.
Expecting healing to manifest.
Provision to arrive, peace to flood your heart.
Why? Because God honors faith.
Heaven honors faith, angels honor faith.
Now, let me warn you.
The enemy will try to talk you out of this.
He will say it is too simple.
It cannot work for you.
You are not spiritual enough.
You are not worthy enough.
But none of that matters.
These five words are not rooted in your performance.
They are rooted in His victory.
It is finished, healing is mine.
Jesus has won.
Angels go now, I will rest.
That is not your power speaking.
That is His covenant speaking through you.
So tonight when you turn off the light, you will not turn off your faith.
You will speak, you will rest, and you will wake up expecting a miracle.
Because overnight miracles are not reserved for the few.
They are prepared for the faithful.
Now, I know how some people think.
I have been in ministry long enough to hear every kind of question.
Father Gachall, is this really biblical?
This whole idea of speaking words before bed, commissioning angels, and expecting miracles overnight.
Does not that sound a bit too easy, too good to be true?
Well, let me tell you something, my friend.
The gospel is good news because it is better than we think, not worse.
And faith was never meant to be complicated.
Faith works because God made it simple for his children to access his promises.
This is not about superstition.
It is not about formulas or spiritual rituals.
It is about understanding how heaven operates through faith and words.
From Genesis to Revelation, the Bible reveals a God who works through his word.
